This looks like OCR errors. "dective" = "defensive", "horlemen" = "horsemen". So the claim is: Helmet is ancient defensive armour worn by horsemen both in war and in tournaments.

Now let's look at the passages:
[W1] Chalcidian helmet, bronze, ancient warriors of Hellenic world, popular in Greece 5th-4th centuries BC, also worn in Greek parts of Italy. This is about warriors, not specifically horsemen, not tournaments.
[W4] Description of helmet structure, hemispherical dome, cheek pieces, neck guard, nasal bar, Chalcidian vs Lucanian. Not about horsemen or tournaments.
[W3] Development of Corinthian helmet, improvements giving better hearing and vision, lighter and less bulky. Not about horsemen or tournaments.

None of the passages mention horsemen or tournaments. They mention ancient warriors (Hellenic world), but not specifically horsemen, and not tournaments.

So the verdict is "not_in_wikipedia" because no passage covers the claim about horsemen and tournaments.
